Senior Software Engineer — Backend Systems
Company: TechScale Solutions
Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our backend platform team. You will design and build scalable microservices, mentor junior engineers, and drive technical architecture decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services using Python and Go
- Build and optimize RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints
- Architect and implement microservices using Kubernetes and Docker
- Design and optimize PostgreSQL and Redis data stores
- Implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
- Lead code reviews and mentor junior team members
- Collaborate with product and frontend teams to define API contracts
- Monitor and improve system reliability (99.9% uptime target)
- Write comprehensive unit and integration tests

Required Skills:
- 5+ years of backend development experience
- Strong proficiency in Python and at least one other backend language (Go preferred)
- Deep experience with PostgreSQL and database optimization
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerization
- Experience designing and building RESTful APIs at scale
- Familiarity with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
- Strong understanding of distributed systems principles
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with Go programming language
- Knowledge of GraphQL
- Experience with Redis caching strategies
- Contributions to open-source projects
- Experience with observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
